name: Souma Fuuka
source: A cheerful and easygoing high school girl. Loves sex and money. She engages in compensated dating to satisfy both her hobbies and profits. Her sexy body and assertiveness towards both male and female made her popular to her compensated dating partners. Apparently, she wasn't like this before...
